# KodeKloud

> KodeKloud is the #1 hands-on platform for mastering DevOps, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and AI through interactive labs, certification prep, and guided learning paths.

KodeKloud offers 180+ courses covering trending technologies including AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and AI. The platform combines hands-on labs, video instruction, and certification preparation to help engineers advance their careers in DevOps, cloud, and infrastructure roles.

## Core Platform

- [KodeKloud Home](https://www.kodekloud.com): KodeKloud homepage: #1 DevOps course provider for trending tech
- [Courses](https://kodekloud.com/courses): 180+ DevOps, Cloud & AI courses with personalized learning paths
- [Learning Paths](https://kodekloud.com/learning-paths): Curated learning paths for DevOps, Kubernetes, and cloud roles
- [Get Started](https://kodekloud.com/sales): KodeKloud sales/signup page with free trial access offer

## Kubernetes Learning Paths

- [Kubernetes Learning Path](https://kodekloud.com/learning-path/kubernetes): Kubernetes learning path: containers, networking, Helm, Istio
- [Kubernetes Administrator Learning Path](https://kodekloud.com/learning-path/kubernetes-administrator): Kubernetes administrator path: CKA certification, container orchestration
- [Golden Kubestronaut](https://kodekloud.com/learning-path/golden-kubestronaut): Golden Kubestronaut path: KCNA, CKA, CKAD, CKS certifications
- [Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) Course](https://kodekloud.com/courses/certified-kubernetes-security-specialist-cks): CKS certification prep for Kubernetes security and hardening
